reason: Canonical supervisor 9.13 requires every new forensic evidence packet to bind exact current FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION and SUPERVISOR_INBOX/selected-steering identity. Existing INGEST_PACKET_SCHEMA.json validates packet structure but does not encode this currentness check.
semantic_validation: For CURRENT_AUTHORITY_BOUND, all authority source identities must equal the newest canonical main identities at ingest time.
A stale, missing or mismatched authority binding may preserve source/historical forensic value but mints no runtime, base, canonical semantics or training credit.
HISTORICAL_SOURCE_EPOCH must never be represented as admitted/current authority.
Packet schema validity and authority currentness are separate gates; both are required for current evidence admission.
Worker packet repetition or cross-model agreement does not create independent runtime evidence.

known_schema_drift.directive_target_action_vocabulary: The current Triggerword-5 directive text uses shorthand REPLACE/RETIRE in one descriptive list, while INGEST_PACKET_SCHEMA.json permits REPLACE_WITH_VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR and RETIRE_WITH_EVIDENCE. Packet producers must obey the machine schema until the prose directive is versioned/reconciled.
known_schema_drift.authority_binding_not_machine_required_i: INGEST_PACKET_SCHEMA.json currently has no required authority_binding field. This contract is therefore a semantic admission gate pending a versioned machine-schema successor; do not silently retrofit old immutable packets.
